---
title: "Métaux et santé : enquête au cœur de notre organisme"
date: 2026-06-16
description: "Discussion with the Fondation Université Grenoble Alpes on metals, environmental exposure, human tissues and the Metals & Health programme."
categories: [Metals & Health, Outreach, Environmental Health, LIBS]
---

I was invited by the **Fondation Université Grenoble Alpes** for the programme *1 heure – 1 chercheur* to discuss the scientific, medical and societal questions behind the **Metals & Health** programme.

The conversation focused on a central question: where do metallic particles that we inhale, ingest or touch end up in the body, and what can their distribution tell us about exposure and health?

The discussion also covered the contribution of **LIBS elemental imaging**, the patient-centred rationale of the programme, prevention, and the need for scientifically validated approaches to questions surrounding metals and health.
